name: @repo/ai
description: Thin wrapper so turbo can run the Python service's tasks alongside the TypeScript ones.

scripts.dev: bun --env-file=../../.env run uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000
scripts.start: bun --env-file=../../.env run uv run fastapi run app/main.py --port 8000
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
